subject: Media Literacy
title: Allied Propaganda in World War II
description: A quick, practical guide to Allied Propaganda in World War II.

hook.text: Rosie the Riveter told women they could do factory work. It was propaganda — and it was effective.

buildup.text: Allied nations used posters, films, and radio to maintain morale and demonize the Axis powers.

discovery.text: Disney made anti-Nazi cartoons. Hollywood was drafted into the propaganda effort.

twist.text: After the war, much Allied propaganda was celebrated as patriotic — because the winners write history.

climax.text: Propaganda isn't just a tool of villains. 'Good' causes use it too.

punchline.text: The winners call it morale. The losers call it propaganda.

quiz.question: Why is Allied WWII propaganda often viewed positively?
options: The winners write history and reframe their propaganda
